AgentResolvedKey.description:
A frontmatter key of a resolved document: a top-level key, or one
permission action as `permissions.<action>`.

first_line.description: Its first and last line in the result's `text`, 1-based.

replaced.description: The inherited block it replaced, as written.

source.description: The tree path of the document of the chain it came from.

AgentResolvedPrompt.description: The inherited prompt in a resolved document's body.

first_line.description: Its first and last line in the result's `text`, 1-based.

source.description: The tree path of the document whose prompt it is.

AgentResolvedValue.description: A model variable, such as `${default_model}`, and what it resolves to.

chain.description: The tree paths of the documents merged, the agent's own first.

comments.description:
Whether `text` keeps the documents' comments; `false` when the
daemon fell back to the merged frontmatter written out without them.

keys.description: Where each frontmatter key came from.

own_document.description:
Whether `chain` starts with a document of the user's for the agent
asked for; `false` for an ACP agent that follows its template, and
for an official document.

prompt.description:
The lines the inherited prompt took, when `{{default_prompt}}` (or
an empty body) brought one in.

text.description: The resolved document, frontmatter and body.

values.description:
The model variables the frontmatter names, with what they resolve
to.
